project.title: The Heritage Short
project.description: A cinematic family heritage story inspired by community memory and intergenerational connection.

characters.description: A fictional, original older community storyteller, warm and dignified, no real-person likeness.

shots.image_prompt: A warm Ethiopian highland town at dawn, textured walls, soft golden light, cinematic documentary style.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow aerial descent toward the town.
shots.narration: በዚህ መንደር ታሪክ በእያንዳንዱ ቤት ውስጥ ኑሯል።

shots.image_prompt: A fictional family courtyard, handmade textiles, clay jars, and morning light.
shots.narration: ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ በጥበብ እና በታሪክ ተያይዘዋል።

shots.image_prompt: Hands weaving a traditional textile at a wooden loom, intimate close-up, warm side light.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow close-up push with fibers in focus.
shots.narration: እያንዳንዱ ክር ቀደም የኖሩ ሰዎችን ማስታወሻ ይይዛል።

shots.image_prompt: A fictional elder and young adult share tea beside a window, silhouettes and dust motes.
shots.motion_prompt: Static shot with subtle handheld warmth.
shots.narration: ትኩስ ጠላት ዙሪያ ያለው ተውሳክ ድምጽ ይኖራል።

shots.image_prompt: A community courtyard gathering, original fictional participants, banners and earth-toned clothing.
shots.narration: እንባ ብቻ አይደለም፤ ትውልድ አንድነትን ይገነባል።

shots.image_prompt: Young people restoring an old community structure, dust, sunlight, cinematic wide shot.
shots.motion_prompt: Forward tracking shot through the work.
shots.narration: ዛሬ የደረሰው ጥበብ ከነገ አዲስ ቅርጽ ይሰጣል።

shots.image_prompt: Children walking along a hillside at sunset, weaving a line of warm silhouettes.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow side dolly following the group.

shots.image_prompt: Quiet sunset over the fictional town, one lit window in the foreground, contemplative wide frame.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push toward the lit window, then gentle hold.
shots.narration: ውርስ የሰዎች ማስታወሻ፣ ተጠቃሚነት እና ተስፋ ድርሻ ነው።
shots.music_cue: Resolve gently to a single traditional instrument
